Projects

FAST-Core

 FAST-Core: Developed a test automation framework designed to support functional testing across diverse subsystems and use cases.

 Enabled integration with various subsystems, facilitating end-to-end testing workflows.  Designed to increase test coverage and reduce manual testing efforts.

CaseTracker v2.0

 CaseTracker v2.0: Developed automated software (Prepaid 360) designed to execute predefined steps at runtime in prepaid call centers.

 Automated query resolution by guiding advisors through pre-configured scenarios tailored to customer issues.

 Streamlined call center operations by automating the resolution steps and providing clear instructions to advisors.

Prepaid 360 v1.0

 Prepaid 360 v1.0: Automated software designed to execute predefined steps for resolving queries in prepaid call centers.

 Guided call center advisors through pre-configured scenarios, ensuring consistent and accurate query resolution processes.  Automated the resolution of customer inquiries, resulting in streamlined operations and improved efficiency.

hello1 and hellotv

 hello1 and hellotv: Contributed to the development of video, music, and movie streaming platforms, delivering on-demand content to subscribers.

 Supported streaming and downloadable media for a wide array of mobile devices, maximizing accessibility.

 Enabled content delivery services for Vodafone and Idea customers, expanding audience reach and service availability.

DU hellotv

 DU hellotv: Developed and delivered a video and movie on-demand service platform used by subscribers in Dubai.  Enabled streaming entertainment, contributing to enhanced accessibility of digital content.

SMS_v1.0 (School Management System)

 SMS_v1.0 (School Management System): Designed a web application to streamline operations for clients running Smart schools.

 Enabled parents to monitor and engage with their child's education through real-time access to progress reports, attendance, and school activities; facilitated communication with teachers through reviews and remarks.

 Empowered teachers with tools to manage their timetables, upload assignments, track attendance, and access employment- related information; streamlined administrative tasks and enhanced efficiency.

 Provided students with a centralized portal for accessing their timetables, homework, attendance records, and submitting assignments, fostering self-directed learning and organization.

Multi-Level Marketing (Web Application)

 Multi-Level Marketing (MLM) Application: Designed an online MLM software platform to facilitate member management, income/expense tracking, and income distribution.

 Automated the tracking of member income and expenses, providing transparent reporting and financial management for MLM businesses.

 Enabled automated income distribution among beneficiaries and rewards allocation upon achieving targets, streamlining operational efficiency.

 Provided graphical representations of the MLM genealogy, aiding in organizational visibility and strategic planning.

iSELAS

 iSELAS: Enhanced sales force effectiveness through an iPad application leveraging the core SELAS platform.  Developed using the Antenna Mobility Platform (AMP) and deployed to a pilot group spanning five countries.

 Improved mobile access to sales tools and data, empowering sales teams in the field.  Focused on enhancing the efficiency for a hundred users.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
Projects
FAST-Core
 FAST-Core: Developed a test automation framework designed to support functional testing across diverse subsystems and use cases.
 Enabled integration with various subsystems, facilitating end-to-end testing workflows.  Designed to increase test coverage and reduce manual testing efforts.
CaseTracker v2.0
 CaseTracker v2.0: Developed automated software (Prepaid 360) designed to execute predefined steps at runtime in prepaid call centers.
 Automated query resolution by guiding advisors through pre-configured scenarios tailored to customer issues.
 Streamlined call center operations by automating the resolution steps and providing clear instructions to advisors.
Prepaid 360 v1.0
 Prepaid 360 v1.0: Automated software designed to execute predefined steps for resolving queries in prepaid call centers.
 Guided call center advisors through pre-configured scenarios, ensuring consistent and accurate query resolution processes.  Automated the resolution of customer inquiries, resulting in streamlined operations and improved efficiency.
hello1 and hellotv
 hello1 and hellotv: Contributed to the development of video, music, and movie streaming platforms, delivering on-demand content to subscribers.
 Supported streaming and downloadable media for a wide array of mobile devices, maximizing accessibility.
 Enabled content delivery services for Vodafone and Idea customers, expanding audience reach and service availability.
DU hellotv
 DU hellotv: Developed and delivered a video and movie on-demand service platform used by subscribers in Dubai.  Enabled streaming entertainment, contributing to enhanced accessibility of digital content.
SMS_v1.0 (School Management System)
 SMS_v1.0 (School Management System): Designed a web application to streamline operations for clients running Smart schools.
 Enabled parents to monitor and engage with their child's education through real-time access to progress reports, attendance, and school activities; facilitated communication with teachers through reviews and remarks.
 Empowered teachers with tools to manage their timetables, upload assignments, track attendance, and access employment- related information; streamlined administrative tasks and enhanced efficiency.
 Provided students with a centralized portal for accessing their timetables, homework, attendance records, and submitting assignments, fostering self-directed learning and organization.
Multi-Level Marketing (Web Application)
 Multi-Level Marketing (MLM) Application: Designed an online MLM software platform to facilitate member management, income/expense tracking, and income distribution.
 Automated the tracking of member income and expenses, providing transparent reporting and financial management for MLM businesses.
 Enabled automated income distribution among beneficiaries and rewards allocation upon achieving targets, streamlining operational efficiency.
 Provided graphical representations of the MLM genealogy, aiding in organizational visibility and strategic planning.
iSELAS
 iSELAS: Enhanced sales force effectiveness through an iPad application leveraging the core SELAS platform.  Developed using the Antenna Mobility Platform (AMP) and deployed to a pilot group spanning five countries.
 Improved mobile access to sales tools and data, empowering sales teams in the field.  Focused on enhancing the efficiency for a hundred users.
